deadline.value: International applicants apply by March 1, 2027 for Fall 2027; apply nine months ahead.

gre_general.quote: The GRE is NOT required for admission

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test exists for computer science.

supervisor.value: You must secure a School of Computer Science faculty advisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must identify a secured School of Computer Science (SoCS) Graduate Faculty Advisor BEFORE applying. Finding a SoCS research advisor is mandatory for admission into the PhD.CS program and the responsibility of the applicant.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student with an advisor is guaranteed at least CAD 25,000 a year (TA plus RA).
funding.quote: a minimum funding stipend of $25,000 per year is guaranteed to all international and domestic PhD students who are able to secure a graduate faculty advisor and secure admission to the program.

entry_route.value: A thesis-based master's in computer science or a close field is required.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD program requires a recognized master’s degree in computer science (or a closely related discipline) that includes a thesis or a major independent project.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100, with speaking and writing 25 and at least 21 in each section (higher than the university minimum).
toefl_min.quote: The English language requirements for the PhD program are higher than other programs. | TOEFL (and TOEFL Special Home Edition): 100, speaking and writing 25, at least 21 in each category

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.5 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS (and Computer-delivered IELTS): 7.0, at least 6.5 for each component

english_waiver.value: A waiver is considered only for degrees from countries where English is the native language (e.g. Canada, UK, USA, Australia), so Indian applicants need a test.
english_waiver.quote: applicants may be eligible for an English Waiver who have conferred a degree in a country where English is the native language AND in a university where English is the language of instruction (e.g. Canada, UK, USA, Australia, etc.)
